title: The Turncloak
description: Two contracts in a row went bad the way they only go bad when the other side already knew the route. Corporal Dain Wexley has owed a Dalhurst moneylender since before he enlisted. Bring me proof before you bring me a name.

objectives.description: Ask around the Iron Hall about Dain's debts
Check whether the Elder Moor outpost was compromised too
Find what Dain sent the moneylender's agent
Confront Dain with what you found
Decide Dain's sentence yourself, if it comes to that
Report to Steele what Dain did and why

notes: Named traitor Corporal Dain Wexley, invented with a debt motive per Step 3's directive - no bible basis. Threat: two ambushed contracts, a route sold to whoever paid Dain's debt collector. Giver motive: Steele needs proof before he acts, having learned that lesson before. Consequence: handle_justice (execute or exile) is a single optional kill objective with no choice_consequences - the description's stated dilemma is not mechanically forked. A full fix needs a real OR group for mercy vs execution, which this pass cannot add.
